newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico says one firm left in first rail sell-off.
newsitem.headline: Mexico says one firm left in first rail sell-off.

text.p: Only one company remains in the bidding process for the first of Mexico's planned privatizations of the country's rail network, the Communications and Transportation Ministry said Wednesday.

Mining giant Grupo Mexico is the last remaining company in the bidding process after Grupo Tribasa and Transportacion Ferroviaria Mexicana both pulled out of the sell-off of the Chihuahua-Pacific railway in the north of the country.
Tribasa said it decided to "abstain from putting forward an offer" and Transportacion Ferroviaria Mexicana said it had no further interest in taking part of the auction, the ministry said.
Results of the auction are scheduled to be announced October 9. Originally, 33 companies had shown interest in the privatization.
